# Ingestion and Data-Loss Requirements Checklist: Supported Trade Ingestion

**Purpose**: Review whether the ingestion, boundary, duplicate, loss-detection, failure, status,
compatibility, and privacy requirements are complete, clear, consistent, and measurable before
implementation
**Created**: 2026-09-09
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `$speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.
**Implementation Gate**: Patrick's validation of the 2026-09-09 planning package is required before implementation; the agent that generated this checklist left every item unchecked.

## Source and Coverage Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are the source endpoint, its anonymous access, and the required wallet-bearing fields specified precisely enough that a schema change is detectable rather than silently tolerated? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001–FR-002; Contract §Source Acquisition]
- [ ] CHK002 Is the all-participant default and the explicit taker-only mode stated with the exact provider parameter so the provider default can never be inherited silently? [Clarity, Spec §FR-015; Research §Decision 2]
- [ ] CHK003 Are the request cadence, the recovery request, and the retry burst each bounded against the published 200-per-10-seconds limit with a stated share, and does the configured minimum interval preserve the 5% ceiling? [Measurability, Spec §FR-018; Contract §Request Budget]
- [ ] CHK004 Is the rejected WebSocket source and the reason it cannot supply wallet identity documented where a future maintainer would look before reintroducing it? [Traceability, Spec §Assumptions; Research §Decision 1]

## Boundary Proof and Loss Detection

- [ ] CHK005 Is "reached the prior durable boundary" defined by both a timestamp condition and a retained-identity condition, with page length explicitly excluded as evidence? [Clarity, Spec §FR-017; Contract §Proof Before Advance]
- [ ] CHK006 Is the bounded recovery limited to the single documented offset page, with the rejected cursor-by-time alternative recorded so it is not retried? [Completeness, Spec §FR-017; Research §Decision 4; Evidence §Sample 5]
- [ ] CHK007 Are the possible-data-loss state, the frozen durable boundary, and the provisional in-memory boundary defined so that new observations keep flowing without advancing across the gap? [Consistency, Spec §FR-017; Contract §Possible-Data-Loss State]
- [ ] CHK008 Is the aged-gap outcome (recorded loss event and re-anchor) stated as a decision requiring Patrick's confirmation, with the stricter stall alternative described? [Assumption, Plan §Design Decisions 3; Plan §Items Requiring Patrick's Decision]
- [ ] CHK009 Are loss events specified with interval, reason, detection time, and retention so an operator can explain any uncovered interval after the fact? [Completeness, Data Model §Loss events]
- [ ] CHK010 Does the specification distinguish an empty successful response from an unproven page and from a failure? [Clarity, Spec §FR-010; Contract §Proof Before Advance]
- [ ] CHK011 Is the reachable depth (20,000 rows) reconciled with the 10-minute recovery horizon so the restart promise is not overstated? [Consistency, Spec §Assumptions; Evidence §Limitations]

## Identity and Duplicate Semantics

- [ ] CHK012 Is the composite identity tuple enumerated field by field, including decimal canonicalization, so two implementations would compute the same identity? [Clarity, Data Model §Identity tuple]
- [ ] CHK013 Are legitimate multiple wallet rows per transaction and exact repeated rows distinguished with measurable evidence from the probes? [Coverage, Spec §FR-005; Evidence §Sample 3]
- [ ] CHK014 Is the identity retention window bound to the recovery horizon with a stated memory expectation? [Measurability, Research §Decision 6]
- [ ] CHK015 Are the crash semantics (at most one re-delivery, never silent loss) stated together with the downstream guard that absorbs the single re-delivery? [Edge Case, Contract §Crash Semantics]

## Row Validity and Repair

- [ ] CHK016 Are identity-bearing required fields and repairable optional fields listed exhaustively, and is invention of missing values explicitly prohibited? [Completeness, Spec §FR-004; Research §Decision 11]
- [ ] CHK017 Is the outcome-repair path defined so that absent metadata neither blocks ingestion nor hides that the outcome is unknown downstream? [Consistency, Spec §FR-003–FR-004; Data Model §Trade Observation]
- [ ] CHK018 Are future-timestamp, padding, and invalid dispositions each defined with their effect on the boundary? [Coverage, Data Model §Row Disposition]
- [ ] CHK019 Are invalid-row diagnostics required to be wallet-free and bounded per cycle? [Security, Spec §FR-004; Contract §What Acquisition Never Does]

## Failure, Retry, and Terminal Behavior

- [ ] CHK020 Are transient and terminal failure classes enumerated by HTTP status and transport condition, including the documented throttling-by-delay behavior? [Completeness, Spec §FR-008; Contract §Response Acceptance]
- [ ] CHK021 Are retry count, backoff base, cap, jitter, and `Retry-After` handling quantified? [Measurability, Spec §FR-008; Research §Decision 9]
- [ ] CHK022 Is the boundary between this slice's terminal `failed` state and slice 003's pipeline-state and CLI-exit propagation stated so neither slice claims the other's outcome? [Boundary, Spec §SC-003; Contract §Pipeline Integration]
- [ ] CHK023 Is clean cancellation specified for an in-flight request and an in-progress callback without a partial checkpoint? [Edge Case, Plan §Design Decisions 5]

## Startup and Restart

- [ ] CHK024 Are first start, restart inside the horizon, and restart beyond the horizon each defined with their emission and loss-event behavior? [Coverage, Spec §FR-006–FR-007; Contract §First Start and Restart]
- [ ] CHK025 Is acquisition start independent of the metadata crawl stated with a measurable bound and a test that can observe the ordering? [Measurability, Spec §FR-003, §SC-002]
- [ ] CHK026 Does switching coverage mode or source URL start a fresh boundary explicitly rather than mixing identity spaces? [Edge Case, Contract §Keys]

## Status and Observability

- [ ] CHK027 Do the required status fields include last successful acquisition, last trade time, consecutive failures, duplicates, invalid rows, loss events, and request budget, each with a definition? [Completeness, Spec §FR-009; Data Model §Ingestion Status]
- [ ] CHK028 Are provider lag and processing lag defined separately so a healthy source with a slow downstream is not misreported? [Clarity, Contract §Status Snapshot]
- [ ] CHK029 Are metric names, types, and labels fixed so slice 003 can bind health routes without renaming? [Consistency, Contract §Metrics]

## Configuration Compatibility

- [ ] CHK030 Is the `POLYMARKET_WS_URL` deprecation window defined with load-time warning, configuration-check output, scheme rejection, non-use, and the later approved removal step? [Completeness, Spec §FR-011; Contract §Configuration Compatibility]
- [ ] CHK031 Are the new trades settings, their defaults, ranges, and validation errors specified so documentation and runtime cannot disagree? [Clarity, Data Model §Source Configuration]
- [ ] CHK032 Is the retained deprecated Python surface described so that it cannot be mistaken for wired production behavior? [Consistency, Research §Decision 14; Constitution §II]

## Privacy, Safe Effects, and Smoke Evidence

- [ ] CHK033 Are the seven smoke cases each assigned a fixture and a verdict rule, and is the wallet-free invariant on the record enforceable by a test? [Measurability, Spec §SC-005; Contract §Seven Named Cases]
- [ ] CHK034 Is the live smoke check excluded from ordinary tests, verifier profiles, and CI, and required only as an explicit bounded command? [Boundary, Spec §FR-013; Constitution §III–IV]
- [ ] CHK035 Is the product stop gate expressed as observable conditions with thresholds rather than judgment, and does it forbid substituting an undocumented feed? [Measurability, Spec §FR-019; Evidence §Product Stop Gate]
- [ ] CHK036 Are the feasibility record's limitations (single period, rate-dependent reach, undocumented behaviors) acknowledged where the freshness and coverage claims are made? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions; Evidence §Limitations]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `$speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `$speckit-specify` and `$speckit-clarify`
- Add comments or findings inline
- Link to relevant resources or documentation
- Items are numbered sequentially for easy reference
